name: Puppet Forge modules
auth: Supply an access/reference token using --forge_authorization "Bearer $AW_TOKEN". The token subject requires read permission for the root module and dependencies; publication requires deploy permission. Keep token arguments out of shared process logs.
fresh_home: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.
prerequisites: Valid Forge module archives and dependency versions available through the repository.

configure.note: Use a fresh modules directory and vardir for each installation.

publish.note: Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

steps.code:
curl --fail --silent --show-error --header "Authorization: Bearer $AW_TOKEN" --upload-file acme-helper-1.0.0.tar.gz "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/acme-helper/acme-helper-1.0.0.tar.gz"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --header "Authorization: Bearer $AW_TOKEN" --upload-file acme-widget-1.0.0.tar.gz "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/acme-widget/acme-widget-1.0.0.tar.gz"
steps.note: Upload valid Puppet module archives with metadata.json; publish dependencies as well as the root module.

install.note: Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

steps.code: env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" puppet module install acme-widget --module_repository "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/puppet/$AW_REPO" --target-dir "$AW_WORK/modules" --modulepath "$AW_WORK/modules" --vardir "$AW_WORK/var" --confdir "$AW_WORK/conf" --forge_authorization "Bearer $AW_TOKEN"
steps.note: The native client resolves and installs module dependencies through the same Forge endpoint.

limitations: This pins the public Puppet client; commercial Puppet Core versions are not claimed.
The public Puppet client uses the supported Ruby 3.3 line because its dependency resolution failed on the attempted Ruby 4 base. The client inventory records the current patch.

contains: fresh Puppet installs from local and one-node federated repositories
Puppet resolves the root module and dependency across virtual members
